Class EntityManagerFactoryImpl

java.lang.Object
org.apache.openjpa.persistence.EntityManagerFactoryImpl
All Implemented Interfaces:
EntityManagerFactory, PersistenceUnitUtil, PersistenceUtil, Serializable, AutoCloseable, Closeable, OpenJPAEntityManagerFactory, OpenJPAEntityManagerFactorySPI
public class EntityManagerFactoryImpl extends Object implements OpenJPAEntityManagerFactory, OpenJPAEntityManagerFactorySPI, Closeable, PersistenceUnitUtil
Implementation of EntityManagerFactory that acts as a facade to a BrokerFactory.
Author:
Marc Prud'hommeaux

    • getNamedQueries

      public <R> Map<String, TypedQueryReference<R>> getNamedQueries(Class<R> resultType)
      Return the named queries whose declared result type is assignable to the given result type.

      The declared result type of a query is QueryMetaData.getResultType() if set, otherwise QueryMetaData.getCandidateType() - managed result classes are recorded as the candidate type by the metadata parsers, exactly as createNamedQuery(name, resultClass) would do. Named queries without any declared result type (i.e. a JPQL @NamedQuery without resultClass, or a query declared in XML - the bundled orm_3_2 schema does not allow a result-class attribute on named-query) are never returned, for any result type including Object.class, because their result type cannot be proven.

      The hints carried by the returned references are the hints of the named query, including the OpenJPA specific hints synthesized by the parsers (e.g. openjpa.FetchPlan.ReadLockMode derived from @NamedQuery.lockMode()); these are exactly the hints replayed by createNamedQuery.

      A freshly computed, modifiable map is returned on every call; it is not a live view of the metadata repository.

      Specified by:
      getNamedQueries in interface EntityManagerFactory
